rca of the issue: The two parsing fixes verified here address PDFs that put dollars only in a per-category cost-share summary table (no per-line-item amounts). Statement side (agents.py _recover_category_level_totals + _parse_category_cost_table): previously the per-line-item extractor summed to ~$0 while reported_total_gross = $3,904.70, triggering RULE_G2_GROSS_RECONCILE and blocking publish; the new fallback engages only when summed per-line gross <= 5% of reported_total_gross AND a category table reconciles to that total, then synthesises stream-level line items (Clinical/Independence/EverydayLiving) that make the gross recon balance. Invoice side (lib/inv1/extractor.py _parse_invoice_category_table): previously the invoice parser read 14/11/2026 from the 'Due' field as a service_date and raised the false C5 'service date after invoice date'; the new fallback engages only when a 'what you are paying for'/'your share' + 'total payable'/'sub-total' table is present and category rows reconcile, then emits 4 category lines with service_date=null (so C5 cannot trigger) and sets invoice_total=222.38. Both fallbacks are guarded so the normal per-line format is untouched (confirmed by regression test).
